Traffic Advisory

There will be increased movement of Kanwarias & Dak Kanwar on Yudhister Setu & Boulevard Road. Additionally, a large number of devotees are expected to visit Hanuman Mandir, Yamuna Bazar, on Tuesday, 22nd July 2025. Additionally, As a result, traffic congestion is expected along the Ring Road, particularly on Mahatma Gandhi Marg, Yudhister Setu, and Boulevard Road.

In view of this, the following traffic restrictions will be in place on 22.07.2025 from 9 AM till 12 Midnight:

Yudhister Setu: Movement of buses and commercial vehicles will be prohibited on the carriageway from Tis Hazari to Shahdara.

Boulevard Road: Movement of commercial vehicles will be prohibited from ISBT Kashmiri Gate towards Tis Hazari.

Lothian Road:- Movement of commercial vehicles will be prohibited from GPO Chowk to ISBT Kashmiri Gate. 

In order to avoid inconvenience to general public, traffic will be diverted from certain points which are as under:-  

-Kashmiri Gate Metro Gate No. 05 on Boulevard Road, ascending foot of Yudhister Setu.
-Near out gate of ISBT Kashmiri Gate on Ring Road. 
-GPO Chowk

Commercial vehicles coming from Hanuman Mandir side via Ring Road (MGM), and going towards Tis Hazari will be diverted from out gate of ISBT Kashmiri Gate and they will proceed via Ring Road towards Yamuna Marg- Raj Niwas Marg- Rajpur Road- Dr. Karnwal Road and reach at Baraf Khana Chowk and will proceed further accordingly. 

Buses and Commercial vehicles coming from Tiz Hazari side and going towards Yudhister Setu, will be diverted from Kashmiri Gate Metro Gate No. 5 and they will proceed towards Ring Road- left turn- U-turn from Monastery- Ring Road- Hanuman Mandir- Outer Ring Road- Akshardham Mandir- NH-24 and will proceed further accordingly. 

Commuters are advised to avoid these road stretches and plan their journey accordingly.
